excluded_fj.FJ1363: Alternate/segmental right ophthalmic nerve component whose bounds do not match left FJ3921; FJ4019 selected as the mirror-matching component.
excluded_fj.FJ1381: Alternate right trochlear nerve generation whose bounds/volume do not match the left FJ3981; FJ4039 selected as the mirror-matching component.
excluded_fj.FJ1746: Alternate lower-resolution generation of left inferior temporal gyrus; FJ7473 selected from the coherent high-resolution FJ747x cortical family.
excluded_fj.FJ1747: Alternate lower-resolution generation of right inferior temporal gyrus; FJ7473M selected from the coherent high-resolution FJ747x cortical family.
excluded_fj.FJ1803: Unsided choroid-plexus component geometrically duplicate of FJ3855 (right lateral ventricle); FJ1755 + FJ3855 selected as explicit left/right concepts.
excluded_fj.FJ1835: Broader alternate generation of left superior parietal lobule (32.81 cm3 versus 17.18 cm3 for FJ7463); excluded provisionally to avoid double-volume overlap, pending visual/faculty review.
excluded_fj.FJ1836: Broader alternate generation of right superior parietal lobule (32.78 cm3 versus 17.14 cm3 for FJ7463M); excluded provisionally to avoid double-volume overlap, pending visual/faculty review.
excluded_fj.FJ1843: Source name says Tentorium cerebelli, but bounds/geometry are the same right-sided component as FJ3889; FJ3889 selected because its concept/name explicitly says right half.
excluded_fj.FJ3848: Exact alternate duplicate of pituitary gland FJ1796 (same centre, dimensions and volume).
excluded_fj.FJ4034: Named trunk of right oculomotor nerve but bounds do not match the left trunk or FJ4033; treated as a non-matching distal/segmental alternate and excluded from the proximal core.
excluded_fj.FJ7446: Alternate generation of right half of tentorium cerebelli overlapping FJ3889, with 822 indexed components and 9 degenerate triangles; FJ3889 selected.
excluded_fj.FJ7484: Alternate tessellation of left anterior nucleus of Hypothalamus with identical bounds/volume to FJ7483; FJ7483 selected because it is a single indexed component before welding.
excluded_fj.FJ7484M: Alternate tessellation of right anterior nucleus of Hypothalamus with identical bounds/volume to FJ7483M; FJ7483M selected because it is a single indexed component before welding.
excluded_fj.FJ7500: Alternate lower-resolution generation of left lingual gyrus occupying the FJ7475 bounds.
excluded_fj.FJ7500M: Alternate lower-resolution generation of right lingual gyrus occupying the FJ7475M bounds.
excluded_fj.FJ7503: Alternate right-half generation of optic chiasm; FJ7505/FJ7505M pair selected because each is a single indexed component.
excluded_fj.FJ7503M: Alternate left-half generation of optic chiasm; FJ7505/FJ7505M pair selected because each is a single indexed component.
